Align.description: Horizontal alignment of each line inside the layout box.

Anchor.description: The safe-zone edge a caption block is placed against.

Applied.description: The result of applying a transaction to a project.

member.description: The member's path inside the archive.

AssetAdd.description:
`asset.add`: what probing found, by kind (plan 4C Task 7). Each kind carries its own
fields and none of the others': `media` a positive `duration` and its `video`/`audio`
streams; `image` and `svg` an `image`; `lottieTemplate` a positive `duration` and `lottie`;
`font` a `font` (with its whole-file SHA-256); `lut` a `lut`.

kind.description: `media` when absent: a sub-project 4B (schema 1) `asset.add` names no kind.

AssetKind.description:
What an asset is: `media` (video and/or audio; every pre-4C asset), `image`, `svg`,
`lottieTemplate` (a dotLottie template with replaceable slots), `font`, or `lut` (a `.cube`
colour lookup table).

AssetMove.description: `asset.move`: puts `asset` in `bin` (at the top when absent).

AudioItem.description:
One item's part of the range: it plays `asset` from `sourceFrom` at `speed` over the
timeline span `[from, to)`. `gain` and `pan` cover that span without gaps, in order. An
item of a nested timeline lists the nested items it sounds through in `via`, outermost
first (its `item` and `track` are its own, on the nested timeline).

AudioParams.description: The item's own audio: gain in dB, pan in −1…1, fades in seconds.

AudioPlan.description: The items sounding in `[from, to)` of one timeline, in track then time order.

Bin.description: A folder of assets; `parent` nests it.

BinAdd.description: `bin.add`: a bin named `name`, inside `parent` when given.

BinMove.description: `bin.move`: puts `bin` inside `parent` (at the top when absent).

BinRemove.description: `bin.remove`: takes the empty `bin` off the project.

BranchCreated.description:
The answer of [`Store::create_branch`](crate::Store::create_branch): the new branch and
its `branch` record on the parent. `dry_run`: planned and rolled back, nothing kept (a
retry of a committed create answers with that create, `dry_run` false).

BranchView.description:
A branch as listings show it ([`Store::branches`](crate::Store::branches), `branch.list`):
`display` is the reference that names it (its name, or `<name>#<id>` for an archived
branch or the second holder of a duplicate name); `head` its head seq (its fork seq until
its first record).

CaptionBox.description: A box behind the block. One equal to the default (transparent, no padding) is no box.

CaptionMerge.description: `caption.merge`: `item` takes in `with`, the next caption on its track.

CaptionPlan.description:
A caption's words at the plan's time, and its layout when it was measured. `layout` is
`null` when it was not, and `unmeasured` says why (plan 4C Decision 36).

words.description: Every word, in order (indices match the layout's word boxes).

CaptionPosition.description:
Where the block sits in its safe zone: against the zone's top, middle or bottom, moved
towards the middle by `offset` (a fraction of the zone's height, 0 to 1).

CaptionSetStyle.description: `caption.setStyle`: `item` takes `style`; `overrides`, when given, replace its overrides.

CaptionSource.description: The transcript artifact a caption came from, and its word range (`[first, end)`).

CaptionSplit.description: `caption.split`: cuts `item` before word `word`; the right part is `id`.

scripts.description:
The ISO 15924 scripts the entry is offered for (a fallback is chosen by these); each
style's default face covers them.

faces.description: Every face, as `fin_text::font_info` reads it (`warm_cache` checks).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the whole file: its cache name and its pin.

size.description: Bytes; a download must match it exactly.

variable.description:
A variable font's `wght` axis. Only a variable file may serve several styles (one per
weight in the range; the request's weight drives the axis).

CatalogSource.description:
Where a file can be fetched. A plain source serves the file itself; an archive source
serves an archive (its own `sha256` and `size`) holding the file as `archive.member`.

defaultFace.description: The face a fallback or an entry-level pin uses (a collection holds several).

sources.description: Tried in order: the upstream first, then mirrors serving the same bytes.

CommittedTx.description: A transaction as persisted: with its revision, resolved bindings and diff.

link.description:
The record's kind and links; omitted for an `edit`. Boxed: most txs are edits, and a
link would double the size of every `CommittedTx`.

Conflict.description:
One op that cannot be carried to the head: which op of which tx, why (a reason code), the
record to blame when there is one (else null), and what to do. A re-run failure keeps its
error's `details` (an `INVALID_RANGE`'s `min` and `max`, say); other conflicts have none.

details.description: Boxed: rarely present, and it keeps `Result<_, Conflict>` small.

CoreError.description: A structured, machine-readable error. `code` is a stable `SCREAMING_SNAKE` string.

Crop.description: Fractions of the item's size cut from each side.

DefaultValue.description:
A spec's default, as its value would be written (`null`: none, the value is per entity or
the parameter is optional).

DeleteMode.description: How a delete leaves its range: `ripple` closes the gap, `lift` leaves it.

Diff.description:
What a transaction changed, op by op: each entry names the op that recorded it (`op`),
and both lists are in op order. An op may record any number of changes and shifts.

Edge.description: Which edge of an item a trim moves.

Effect.description: One effect of an item (`fx<n>`, addressed as `(item, effect)`); `params` is sparse.

EffectAdd.description: `effect.add`: an effect of `kind` on `item` at index `at` (appended when absent).

EffectPlan.description:
One enabled effect with its parameters resolved at the plan's time. `params` holds the
effect's stored and keyframed parameters (the registry's defaults fill the rest).

oneOf.description: A record imported from the folder.
The status changed (fin-store's `ProjectStatus`).

An import took `branch`'s revs from `from_rev` on out of its history: `quarantined`
records were set aside (`own`: some were this server's) and the branch is at
`generation` of database `incarnation` now.

The database was rebuilt: a new `incarnation`, and every rev read before may hold
something else now.
A background tick, backup or compaction failed (`fatal`: the engine is gone).

The first event after registration when the buffer overflowed: `dropped` events
were lost.

FileState.description: A catalog file's state in this server (Decision 34).

oneOf.description: Not cached and not queued: never requested, or background fetching is off.

fallback.description: Entry ids, in the order a text's uncovered scripts look for a fallback.

FontFace.description: One face of a font file, as `fin_text::font_info` reads it.

scripts.description: ISO 15924 script codes the face covers.

FontFile.description: An imported font file (plan 4C Decision 37): its whole-file SHA-256, size, format and faces.

FontFileStatus.description:
One font file. `entry` and `style` name its catalog style, when the catalog lists it;
`keys` are the font keys (`<family>|<weight>|<normal|italic>`) open projects pin it as.

FontPin.description: One face of one exact file: `face` is the index inside a collection (0 for a single font).

scripts.description: ISO 15924 script codes the face covers (as `fin_text::font_info` reports them).

sha256.description: The whole file's SHA-256, 64 lowercase hex digits.

FontPinOp.description: `font.pin`: pins `key` to `pin`, at `fallback` in the fallback order if given.

FontSource.description:
Where a pinned file comes from: a catalog entry's style (at the catalog version that
pinned it), or an imported font asset.

fallbackOnly.description: Internal: drop only the key's fallback place.

Fonts.description:
The pins, keyed by [`font_key`], and the fallback order (pin keys, first tried first).
Empty until a caption edit pins a face; omitted from the project JSON while empty.

FontsPlan.description:
`fonts.plan`: the `font.pin` ops a client prepends to its tx, and notes about faces or
scripts the catalog cannot pin (`FONT_NOT_IN_CATALOG`), which never fail the plan.

FontsStatus.description:
`fonts.status`: every catalog file's state in this server, then the files pinned by open
projects that the catalog does not list (font assets, files of another catalog).

autoFetch.description: Background fetching is on (`fonts.autoFetch`, and `FIN_FONTS_OFFLINE` unset).

damaged.description:
The font cache or the catalog could not be used (`FONTS_DAMAGED`): nothing is
fetched, and only font assets measure.

FramePlan.description: The layers of one timeline at `t`, bottom first.

layers.description:
Bottom first: tracks in compositing order, items in time order within a track (a
transition's outgoing item before its incoming one).

textEngine.description:
The text engine (`TextMeasurer::fingerprint`) that produced the plan's caption layouts;
absent when no caption was measured.

GainSegment.description:
Gain over `[from, to)` in dB: `db` are the end values of the keyframe span the segment
lies in, `u` the segment's progress range through that span, so the dB at progress `x` of
the segment is `lerp(db[0], db[1], ease(lerp(u[0], u[1], x)))` with `ease` from `interp`
(`hold`: `db[0]` throughout). The `shapes` multiply the amplitude.

Generation.description:
A branch generation as a caller holds it: the database's incarnation and the branch's
rewind count in it (module docs).

GraphicPlan.description: A graphic's template, its time (from the item's start) and its slot values.

HistoryResult.description:
The answer of a history operation ([`Store::undo`](crate::Store::undo),
[`Store::redo`](crate::Store::redo)): the records it committed, in order (or planned and
rolled back, `dry_run`; a retry of a committed operation answers with its records,
`dry_run` false), and what they act on: the units an undo undoes, the undo a redo
reverses, or the merge group a revert reverts. `no_op`: why a cherry-pick or revert
committed nothing (`ALREADY_PRESENT`: the target holds the record's origin root;
`ALREADY_REVERTED`: the merge group's effect is gone there); absent otherwise.

InsertMode.description:
How an insert makes room (plan 4C Decision 18): `ripple` moves every later item on the
track by the item's duration; `overwrite` takes the range over, removing the items inside it
and trimming the ones overlapping its ends (an item strictly containing it is
`OVERWRITE_SPLITS_ITEM`: split it first, `compose::overwrite`), and moves nothing else.

Interp.description: How a keyframe's value moves to the next one.

oneOf.description: CSS `cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)`.

Item.description:
One item on a track. On the wire the body's `kind` and fields and the common fields sit
next to `id`, `start` and `duration` (both are flattened).

oneOf.description: A span of a media asset. Source time = `sourceIn + (t − start) × speed`.

Timed words in a caption style. (A struct variant with the block flattened, so the
generated TypeScript keeps the `kind` tag next to the block's fields.)
A Lottie template with its slot values.
A still image or SVG.
Applies its effects to everything below it.
Another timeline of the project.

keyframes.description: Keyframes by registry path, each list sorted by `at`.

link.description: The link group (`lk<n>`) the item belongs to.

ItemInsert.description:
`item.insert`: an item of any kind (the flattened `body`, tagged by `kind`) at `at` on
`track`, `duration` long, with default common fields. `id` is a `$name` placeholder bound
to a new id of the item's kind.

oneOf.description: A span of a media asset. Source time = `sourceIn + (t − start) × speed`.

Timed words in a caption style. (A struct variant with the block flattened, so the
generated TypeScript keeps the `kind` tag next to the block's fields.)
A Lottie template with its slot values.
A still image or SVG.
Applies its effects to everything below it.
Another timeline of the project.

ItemKind.description: The item kinds, as they appear in plans.

ItemLink.description:
`item.link`: makes `items` (at least two, on one timeline, none linked yet) one link group
named `id` (a `$name` placeholder). Internal applies (inverses) may name a literal id: a new
group (the inverse of `item.unlink`, one member included), or an existing one the items
join (the undo of a removal that left a member alone, 4C Tasks 9–10 review).

ItemMove.description:
`item.move`: moves `item` to `track` at `at` (a position in the frame before the op, plan
4C Decision 15), and every member of its link group by the same time on its own track
(only the named item changes track). `ripple` closes the gap it leaves and opens room at
the target on each track; `overwrite` lifts it and carves the target range.

ItemRestore.description:
`item.restore` (internal): puts `item` back on `track` at its `start`. Its id may be a
`$placeholder` (spec §4.3): the item then gets a newly allocated id.

ItemSlide.description:
`item.slide`: moves `item` (alone) by `delta` seconds on its track, trimming the
neighbour touching each side so nothing else moves: the one before it at its end, the one
after it at its start. A side with no touching neighbour needs room in the gap
(`SLIDE_BLOCKED`).

ItemSlip.description:
`item.slip`: moves the source of `item` (a clip or nested item) under it by `delta`
source seconds (`sourceIn += delta`); its place on the timeline and its item-relative times
stay. The source range is policy.

ItemSplit.description:
`item.split`: cuts `item` at `offset` (item-relative seconds, strictly inside it). The left
part keeps the id and ends at `offset`; the right part is a copy (effects keep their ids,
item-relative times move by `−offset`, no link group) named by `id`, a `$name` placeholder.

ItemTrim.description: `item.trim`: moves one edge of `item` by `delta` seconds (positive moves it later).

alone.description:
Internal (every trim's inverse): this item alone, not its link group (plan 4C
Decision 19). A `strict` trim is always alone.

ItemUnlink.description:
`item.unlink`: dissolves link group `group` (internal, with `items`: only those members
leave it).

Keyframe.description: A keyframe; `at` is relative to the item's start (plan 4C Decision 13).

Layer.description:
One item drawn at the plan's time. `local` is the time from the item's start: negative for
a transition's incoming item before its cut, past `duration` for the outgoing one after it.
An adjustment layer carries effects only (its transform and crop are the defaults); a
nested item is a group layer whose `children` are its timeline's layers.

children.description: A nested item's layers, bottom first.

nested.description: A nested item's timeline, time and frame size.

source.description:
The asset and its time: a clip's source time (through speed), an image's 0, a
graphic's template time.

spdx.description: An SPDX id from the permissive allow list (`catalog/rules.json`).

url.description: The licence text at a pinned commit or tag.

LineBox.description:
One line. `x` is the left edge of its ink box after alignment, `top` its top; `baseline` is
measured from the layout's top. `words` is the half-open range of word indices on it.

Link.description:
A record's kind and what it points at (spec §4.2). Serialised (in `CommittedTx.link`) as
`{"kind": "<kind>", …fields}`, camelCase, absent optional fields omitted.

oneOf.description: Undoes `undoes` (unit txIds, newest first).
Reverses the `undo` record `redoes`.
A copy of `origin` from branch `from`, in merge group `merge_id`.

A copy of `origin` (its origin root) from branch `from`; `origin_hash` names the
exact record when known; `recovers`: the quarantined record a recovered copy stands for
(plan 4B Decision 27).
Reverts the merge group `reverts`.
`recovers`: the quarantined record a recovered checkpoint stands for.

Creates branch `branch_id` forking from this record's branch at `fork_seq` (whose
txHash is `fork_hash`, absent at 0), committed at lease epoch `epoch`. `recovers`: the
quarantined `branch` record a recovered branch stands for.

Renames, archives or restores branch `branch_id`. `recovers`: the quarantined
`branchSet` record a recovered one stands for.

LottieInfo.description: A dotLottie template: its canvas, timing, replaceable slots and the font families it names.

MarkerSet.description: `marker.set`: sets `path` of `marker` to `value`; no `value` clears it.

Mask.description: A matte (an artifact reference) that masks the item.

MaskPlan.description: The mask with its values resolved (`feather` and `choke` at least 0).

MergeReport.description:
The answer of [`Store::merge`](crate::Store::merge): merge group `merge_id`'s records on
the target, in order (or planned and rolled back, `dry_run`); `merged`: the source txIds
they copy; `skipped`: the candidates that conflict and were left on the source (with
`skipConflicting`; they are offered again by the next merge); `excluded`: source records
never offered (`UNDOES_TARGET_RECORDS`); `source_state`: the source branch's state after
the merge. A retry of a committed merge answers from the log: its records and their
origins, `skipped` and `excluded` empty, `dry_run` false. Nothing left to merge is an
empty answer, not an error.

NestedPlan.description:
The nested timeline of a group layer, the time evaluated on it (`sourceIn + local`) and
its frame size.

Op.description:
A primitive edit operation, tagged by `op`.

`clip.insert`, `clip.trim` and `clip.delete` are client aliases of the `item.*` ops (plan 4C
Decision 6): [`crate::normalize`] rewrites them before a commit, so a stored transaction
never holds one, and internal and replay applies refuse them (`INVALID_OP`).

oneOf.description: Adds an asset. `id` is a `$name` placeholder bound to a new `a<n>` id.
Places an item on a track at `at`.
Moves one edge of an item by `delta` seconds.
Takes an item off its track.
Moves an item's source under it (`sourceIn`), keeping its timeline place.
Cuts an item in two at `offset`; the right part gets a new id.
Moves an item (and its link group) to a track and position.
Moves an item between its neighbours, trimming them.
Makes items one link group.
Dissolves a link group.
Creates or updates the transition at a cut.
Takes a transition off its track.
Adds an empty track to a timeline.
Takes a track off its timeline (with its items when `withItems`).
Moves a track to another place in its timeline's compositing order.
Sets (or, with no `value`, resets) one setting of a track.
Adds an empty timeline.
Sets (or, with no `value`, resets) one setting of a timeline.
Takes a timeline off the project with everything on it.
Adds a marker to a timeline.
Sets (or, with no `value`, clears) one field of a marker.
Takes a marker off its timeline.
Adds a bin.
Puts a bin inside another one, or at the top.
Takes an empty bin off the project.
Puts an asset in a bin, or at the top.
Internal (inverse of `track.remove`): puts a whole track back.
Internal (inverse of `timeline.remove`): puts a whole timeline back.
Removes an unused asset (also the inverse of `asset.add`).
Internal (inverse of `item.insert`): removes an item.
Internal (inverse of `item.delete`/`item.remove`): puts an item back at its `start`.
Sets (or, with no `value`, resets) one registry parameter of an item.
Adds an effect to an item; `id` is a `$name` placeholder bound to a new `fx<n>` id.
Takes an effect (and the keyframes of its params) off an item.
Moves an effect to another index of its item's effect list.
Sets the keyframe of an item's parameter at an item-relative time.
Removes the keyframe of an item's parameter at an item-relative time.
Internal (inverse of `effect.remove`): puts an effect and its keyframes back.
Adds a project caption style; `id` is a `$name` placeholder bound to a new `st<n>` id.
Sets (or, with no `value`, resets) one path of a project caption style.
Takes an unused project caption style off the project.
Pins a font face to an exact file by SHA-256.
Drops an unused font pin.
Points a pinned font face at another file.
Gives a caption new text, keeping the times of the words that match.
Internal (inverse of the caption edits): sets a caption's words exactly.
Cuts a caption in two before a word; the right part gets a new id.
Joins a caption with the next caption on its track.
Gives a caption another style, and optionally new overrides.
Client alias of `item.insert` of a clip in ripple mode.
Client alias of `item.trim` in ripple mode.
Client alias of `item.delete` in ripple mode.

PanSegment.description: Pan over `[from, to)` (−1 left … 1 right; the mixer clamps), read like [`GainSegment`].

ParamSet.description: `param.set`: sets `path` of `item` to `value`; no `value` resets it to its default.

ParamSpec.description:
One parameter: its path in its scope, type, whether keyframes may animate it, default, unit
and fix text (`{min}`, `{max}`, `{unit}` and `{path}` are filled in errors).

ParamType.description:
A parameter's value type. Times and rationals are canonical rational text (`"1/2"`),
colours `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa` (lowercase), enums their names; a size is whole pixels as
a `vec2`; an asset reference is `{"asset": id}` of one of `kinds`. Ranges are inclusive.

ParamValue.description:
A parameter value: finite numbers round-trip bit for bit through stored JSON (serde_json's
`float_roundtrip`). Times, rationals, colours (`#rrggbb[aa]`) and enum values are text; an
asset reference is `{"asset": id}`, so every id a value carries is found without the
registry (plan 4C Decision 24).

PlanCrop.description:
A layer's crop, resolved at the plan's time: fractions of the item's size cut from each
side, each in `[0, 1]`, every field present.

PlanTransform.description:
A layer's transform, resolved at the plan's time: every field is present (the model's
`Transform` leaves defaults out).

anyOf.description: An asset reference (a `lut` effect's asset, an image slot), `{"asset": id}` as stored.

PlanValue.description: A resolved value (plan 4C Decision 12): colours are sRGB `[r, g, b, a]` in 0…1.

Probe.description:
What the server needs to register an asset: its kind and that kind's fields (the
`asset.add` fields, plan 4C Task 7). Its serde form is what `asset.probe` answers
(`@finisher/core-types` exports it as `Probe`); absent fields are omitted.

font.description: A font's whole-file SHA-256, format and faces (Decision 37).

timelines.description: The first is the main timeline.

Rational.description: Exact rational seconds in canonical form: "n/d" in lowest terms with d > 1, or "n" when d is 1; no leading zeros, no "+", no "-0".

RecoverReport.description:
[`Store::recover`](crate::Store::recover)'s answer: the groups as found (before `create`),
the branches made and every record written (`branch` records on the parents, the copies,
checkpoints, `branchSet` records), in order, for publishing; `imported`: quarantine rows
`import_dir` added or made current again, and `skipped_files` the files it did not read;
`dismissed`: rows `dismiss` set aside from listing and counting; `manual`: the procedure
for a read-only state recovery cannot lift by itself (`CHAIN_FORK`, `CONFLICT_COPY`).

Role.description: Which side of a transition a layer is.

oneOf.description: The outgoing item (A).
The incoming item (B).

Scope.description:
Where a parameter lives. An effect's paths are `<kind>.<param>`; on an item they are
addressed as `effects.<fx>.<param>`.

Shape.description:
A fade or crossfade side over a segment: `p` is its progress at the segment's ends (0 → 1
across the whole fade). Its amplitude factor is `curve(p)` for `fadeIn`/`crossIn` and
`curve(1 − p)` for `fadeOut`/`crossOut` (`linear`: `x`; `equalPower`: `sqrt(x)`-shaped, as
the mixer defines it).

Shift.description:
Items on `track` at or after `from` moved by `by` (ripple), recorded by op `op` of the
transaction.

SkippedFile.description:
A file `import_dir` did not read: its path and why (`not a segment: …`, `another
project`, `unreadable: …`).

SlideSides.description: The neighbours an internal `item.slide` trims; a side without one trims nothing there.

SlotSpec.description: One replaceable slot of a template: its id and value kind (as the template declares it).

SourceRef.description: An asset and the time to read from it, in seconds.

Stacks.description: An author's undo and redo stacks on a branch, bottom first (the top is the last entry).

Stroke.description: An outline around the glyphs. A stroke equal to the default (width 0) is no stroke.

StyleAdd.description: `style.add`: a project style named `name`, from `from`, with `set` applied.

StyleSet.description:
`style.set`: sets `path` of `style` to `value`; no `value` resets it to the default
style's (or removes an optional part).

TextLayout.description:
A measured layout, all lengths in 1/64 px. `width` is the widest line, `height` the
lines' total advance. `overflow` is set when a line is wider than `max_width` or there are
more lines than `max_lines`. `missing` lists the code points no face maps (ascending);
`faces` the sha256s whose glyphs the layout uses, in request order.

TextStyle.description: The style a text is measured with.

letterSpacing.description: Extra advance after every glyph, in em (a multiple of `size`; may be negative).

lineHeight.description: Line advance as a multiple of `size` (e.g. 1.2).

TimelineRemove.description: `timeline.remove`: takes `timeline` off the project with its tracks, items and markers.

TimelineRestore.description: `timeline.restore` (internal): puts `timeline` back at `index` of the project's timelines.

TimelineSet.description: `timeline.set`: sets `path` of `timeline` to `value`; no `value` resets it.

TrackAdd.description: `track.add`: a new empty track of `kind` on `timeline`.

TrackMove.description: `track.move`: puts `track` at `index` of its timeline's tracks.

TrackRemove.description: `track.remove`: takes `track` off its timeline, with its items when `withItems`.

TrackSet.description: `track.set`: sets `path` of `track` to `value`; no `value` resets it.

Transition.description: A transition at the cut between two touching items of one track, centred on the cut.

between.description: The outgoing item, then the incoming one.

TransitionSet.description:
`transition.set`: the transition at the cut between `between[0]` (outgoing) and
`between[1]` (incoming), touching items of `track`, centred on the cut. `id` is a `$name`
placeholder to create one, or the literal id of the one to update (a literal id naming no
transition restores it: internal only).

TransitionState.description: A layer inside a transition window `[cut − d/2, cut + d/2)`: `progress` runs 0 → 1 over it.

TrimMode.description:
How a trim treats the rest of the track: `ripple` moves every later item by the change;
`roll` moves the cut between the item and the neighbour touching that edge (both change,
nothing else moves; `NOT_ADJACENT` without one); `overwrite` moves the edge itself, carving
whatever it extends over and leaving a gap when it shrinks; `strict` (internal: the inverse
of carving edits) moves the edge only, and an overlap it would make is `CLIP_OVERLAP` in
every apply mode.

argsHash.description:
What produced the tx, for a client that sends an idempotency key as `txId`:
`blake3:<64 hex>` of the command input (op kinds and canonical args, before they were
resolved against a snapshot). A retry rebuilds `ops` against a newer head (positions
move; the stored tx is rebased), so `ops` cannot tell a retry from another command;
this can. The store refuses a `txId` it holds with another `argsHash`
(`IDEM_KEY_REUSED`). Stored with the record, so every server that imported it checks.
